title: An Octopus Escaped Its Aquarium Through a 50 Meter Drain Pipe

scenes.text: An octopus escaped an aquarium and slid down a drain to the sea.
His name was Inky, at New Zealand's National Aquarium.
One night he slipped out through a small gap in the top of his tank.
He crossed the floor, then squeezed into a drain pipe only six inches wide.
The pipe ran fifty meters, straight out into the Pacific Ocean.
Staff found no trace of him. An octopus really can escape through a drain.

description:
An octopus named Inky escaped from the National Aquarium of New Zealand and slid down a 50 meter drain pipe into the sea.
Octopuses have no bones, so they can fit through any gap bigger than their beak.
Would you have caught him?
first_comment: How small a hole do you think an octopus can squeeze through?
